rationale: Revision 6 pre-final proposal. It preserves the exact-bound v4 artifacts as failure evidence and binds the passing v5 replacement input/capability manifest and finite-coverage report. Authenticated GitHub comments 5566509712 and 5566572994 ratify the outcome-independent ESM1v_single alias/direction, bind the migration receipt to the accepted Issue #11 terminal inventory, bound the completed summary-only attempt, and conditionally approve main, aggregate-only reproduction and terminal archive resources/operations. The replacement exact-checks all four allowed summary/processing-manifest pairs without opening a raw-score data row or truth file. Final Gate A still requires Mika's findings-focused review of this revision, two fresh authenticated authority comments containing the exact final decision marker and all four major boundaries, their attestation envelopes, manifest_status authorized, and a passing final production contract Check.
